I estimated the ATT by regression adjustment. The data has no true counterfactuals, so this is an estimate and depends on the model. I fit an OLS outcome model on the control group only, using all 25 covariates. I then predicted the untreated outcome for each treated child and averaged the gap between observed and predicted outcomes.

| Method | Estimate |
|---|---|
| Raw difference in means (treated minus control, no adjustment) | 12.10 |
| OLS with a treatment indicator and all covariates (closer to an ATE) | 4.76 |
| Control-only outcome model, averaged over the treated (ATT) | 3.80 |

The raw difference is much larger, which suggests the treated and control groups differ on the covariates. I chose the control-only model because it targets the effect on the treated group specifically.

ANSWER: 3.80
